slides.texte_overlay:
Strange Little Habits That Make
People Trust You Right Away

1. Remember the small thing
they told you last week

• "How did the interview go?"
It shows you were listening.

2. Show up 5 minutes early

• Before anyone hears you speak,
they know you're dependable.

3. Say their name once

• Not ten times. Once.
It makes the moment personal.

4. Let them finish
their sentence

• No interrupting.
People trust who lets them talk.

5. Lend it and never
bring it up again

• Generosity with a receipt
isn't generosity.

6. Know a little
about a lot

• Read widely, 5 minutes a day.
People trust a curious mind.
